// diagnostic

E1309

`#Flag` on `name` has nothing to opt out of

What

`#Flag` on `name` has nothing to opt out of

Why

`#Flag` keeps a required value field flag-only (D-CLI-POS1=A). Bool fields, `T?` fields, and fields with a `{expr}` default are already flag-only.

Fix

remove `#Flag`, or make the field a required scalar without a `{expr}` default.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1309: tests/ui/cli_flag_misuse.stderr.

Error [E1309]: `#[Flag]` on `verbose` has nothing to opt out of
  --> tests/ui/cli_flag_misuse.jet:3:6
    |
  3 |     #Flag verbose: Bool
    |      ^^^^
 Why: `#[Flag]` keeps a required value field flag-only. Bool fields, optional fields (`T?`), and fields with a `{expr}` default already stay flag-only.
 Fix: remove `#[Flag]`, or make the field a required scalar without a `{expr}` default
